title: Shooting Ball
description: Aim and shoot the balls to clear the level and score points.
about:
Shooting Ball is a browser game where you start the game, aim at the balls and shoot to collect points.

Start a round in your browser and use the controls below to play.
howToPlay: Start the game, aim at the balls and shoot to collect points.
tips: Use click / tap to aim and shoot.
Try another round to practice the timing and strategy.

faq.question: How do I play Shooting Ball?
faq.answer: Start the game, aim at the balls and shoot to collect points.

faq.question: Can I play Shooting Ball in a browser?
faq.answer: Yes. Open the game page and play without installing an app.
